name: pi-bulk-sessions
description: Multi-select chat deletion inside pi's own resume browser. /sessions adds a checkbox column to pi's SessionSelectorComponent: alt+s toggles, alt+a toggles all, alt+x deletes the checked chats (trash-safe).
